name: Cta Primary
css: .cta-primary { position: relative; height: 60px; padding: 0 30px; border-radius: 18px; color: #fff; font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(122,50,227,1) 0%, rgba(236,72,153,0.9) 50%, rgba(253,135,61,1) 100%); transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.3s; }
